from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class OperatingProfit(BaseModel):
    """Operating profit data extracted from one company's financial report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The company name as named in the report")
    stock_code: str | None = Field(description="The stock/coding number of the company")
    operating_profit: float | None = Field(description="The operating profit amount in CNY (营业利润)")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period, e.g. '2024年第一季度'")
    is_negative: bool | None = Field(description="Whether the profit is negative or zero")
    quote: str = Field(description="Verbatim excerpt containing the operating profit figure")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    operating_profits: list[OperatingProfit]
